title: The Mahajanapad
subtitle: Many Sovereigns, One Interoperable Civilizational Space

blocks.text: Humanesque becomes a Mahajanapad of enabled individuals and communities.

blocks.caption: The Mahajanapad — Many Sovereigns, One Interoperable Civilizational Space
blocks.explanation: The larger polity exists to enable its constituent sovereigns rather than subsume them, allowing plurality, linguistic diversity and cultural difference within an interoperable civilizational framework.
